recommendation_taxonomy.title: Expedite Inbound Shipment
recommendation_taxonomy.trigger: Stockout projected within lead time window (IP <= 0 for k <= ceil(LT/7))
recommendation_taxonomy.default_action: Contact supplier immediately to expedite delivery or air-freight emergency shipment.

recommendation_taxonomy.title: Issue Purchase Order
recommendation_taxonomy.trigger: Reorder Point breached within lead time window (IP < RP for k <= ceil(LT/7))
recommendation_taxonomy.default_action: Generate and release purchase order to prevent safety stock depletion.

recommendation_taxonomy.title: Review Replenishment Pipeline
recommendation_taxonomy.trigger: Reorder Point breached within 8-week horizon (k > ceil(LT/7))
recommendation_taxonomy.default_action: Review supplier schedule and prepare replenishment requisition for next cycle.

recommendation_taxonomy.title: Halt Inbound Replenishment
recommendation_taxonomy.default_action: Halt or defer new purchase orders; evaluate promotional clearance or stock redistribution.

recommendation_taxonomy.title: Maintain Normal Schedule
recommendation_taxonomy.trigger: Adequate coverage across 8 weeks, no breaches, no excess
recommendation_taxonomy.default_action: No operational intervention required. Continue monitoring weekly demand.

recommendation_taxonomy.title: Snapshot Data Unavailable
recommendation_taxonomy.trigger: Missing inventory snapshot at origin t
recommendation_taxonomy.default_action: Flag to inventory accounting; verify ERP inventory snapshot synchronization.

conflict_resolution_rules.rule: Shortage protection strictly takes precedence over holding cost. Issue EXPEDITE_PO or PLACE_PO, modulating order size to prevent excessive long-horizon inventory.

conflict_resolution_rules.scenario: High Current Stock but Insufficient Projected Inventory
conflict_resolution_rules.rule: Horizon trajectory determines action. Issue replenishment alert based on forward breach week regardless of today's visual stock count.

conflict_resolution_rules.scenario: Low Current Stock but High On_Order arriving within Lead Time
conflict_resolution_rules.rule: On_Order satisfies forward demand under Policy B_LT. Do not order additional units; instruct planner to verify vendor delivery confirmation.

monetary_valuation.policy: valuation_basis_confirmed = False. Monetary fields must remain null/None. Quantities expressed strictly in physical units and weeks of cover.

on_order_timing.policy: arrival_timing_confirmed = False. Delivery dates are estimates based on standard lead time under Policy B_LT.

overstock_threshold.policy: Evaluated against 8-week validated production forecast horizon.

orphan_sku_quarantine.policy: SKU051-SKU200 strictly quarantined. Active universe is SKU001-SKU050.
